subject.name: Endoscopy Technicians
subject.summary: Under U.S. O*NET-SOC 31-9099.02, prepare and maintain endoscopy equipment during endoscopic procedures, assist at the operator's direction, and complete instrument reprocessing and traceability records according to protocol; job training, reprocessing authorization, and infection control requirements must be verified against the original local and institutional texts. (The U.S. wage and employment figures checked are broader-group figures.)
